args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch
the rounding mode to match the FIN-212 requirement and the test suite.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `amount.quantize(...)`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
